# TypeOf

Gives the name of a value's type.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
TypeOf(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | any | The value whose type to name. Any value, null included. |

## Returns

String. One of the strings `"null"`, `"boolean"`, `"number"`, `"string"`, `"array"`, `"object"` or `"function"`. Never null.

## Example

`TypeOf([1, 2])` returns `"array"`.

`TypeOf(null)` returns `"null"`.
